objectives.label: Bring the market charter to {recipient} in {target}

title: The market charter
A charter for {settlement}
summary: {giver} has drawn up a market charter with {target} and needs it carried to {recipient} for their seal.
offer: If {target} seals this charter, their merchants come to our market every week. {recipient} is expecting it. Do not lose it.
complete: Sealed! Market days will be busy from now on. The town is in your debt.
